text:
maya: heads up — cluster-gpu-infra app stuck in SyncBackoff on ArgoCD. saw repeated hook failures, autoscaler stuck with 8 pending nodes.

deploy-bot: ArgoCD: sync failed for app 'cluster-gpu-infra' (rev: v2026-03-17): 4 failed resources, backoff engaged :warning:

sam: can you paste the hook logs?

maya: sure — kube-system post-sync job keeps crashing:
```
Error: could not create rolebinding: roles.rbac.authorization.k8s.io "gpu-autoscaler-role" already exists and is owned by cluster-admin
exit status 1
```

ian: sounds like a Helm post-sync hook trying to create cluster-scoped RBAC in kube-system which ArgoCD can't reconcile safely. hooks run as Jobs and ArgoCD tries to prune them — leads to sync backoffs.

lee: this is why we had a rule to NOT manage kube-system resources from app-of-apps. how did this get included?

maya: AppSet pulled a new chart version that added a clusterRoleBinding as a post-install hook. it slipped through the chart bump.

priya: quick workaround — pause the app in ArgoCD and manually delete the failing hook Job, then patch chart to avoid post-sync hook. careful: nodes might remain allocated until drains finish.

sam: can we add a resource.customizations entry to ignore Jobs for this app? or add `argocd.argoproj.io/sync-options: SkipHooks` on the app? skipping all hooks might hide required migrations though.

ian: long-term: change chart to use pre-install hook or render the RBAC as a regular manifest with ownerReferences so ArgoCD can prune it. also add argocd resource customizations to ignore cluster-scoped changes for that app.

ops-bot: cost-alert: gpu-pool overshot target by 8 A40 nodes overnight. estimated extra spend: ~$5.2k/day. @finance FYI

lee: that billing spike explains the alert from last night. we should throttle autoscaler changes until we have a fix.

maya: action plan: opening PR to change hook to pre-install + add annotations to exclude kube-system-managed resources from AppSet generator. will also patch current Job with `argocd.argoproj.io/sync-options: SkipDryRunOnMissingResource` as a short-term fix.

sam: assigning to eng-infra, marking urgent. i'll help validate on staging.

priya: note — check Terraform state for node-pool autoscaler flags. chart may have written to cluster-autoscaler ConfigMap causing unintended min/max changes; open TF drift ticket.

maya: created issue INFRA-3421, linked PR #672. will canary in us-west-2 first and pause sync everywhere else.

ian: when you patch, run `argocd app sync cluster-gpu-infra --retry` and watch prune waves — we saw prune waves take 10+ minutes when kube-system had orphaned Jobs.

maya: will do. thanks all :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Incident created: INFRA-3421 — ArgoCD sync backoff affecting GPU autoscaler (creator: maya)

lee: follow-up — after fix, update app-of-apps policy doc to forbid cluster-scoped hooks from user charts and add to PR checklist.

maya: noted. will close thread once PR merges.
